sections.heading: Archived Essences
sections.body: Absorbed Essences appear in your Archive. Select an Essence to review its attributes, progression, and available actions like equipping it.

sections.heading: Progression
sections.body: Essences equipped in the loadout used for a battle gain experience when you win. Reach max level and gather the required resources to Ascend an Essence, making it stronger.

sections.heading: Loadouts
sections.body: Combat uses the loadout assigned to its activity, or the first loadout when none is assigned. Equipping and removing Essences saves automatically; use Save name after renaming a loadout.

sections.heading: Creature Archive
sections.body: The Creature Archive records discovered creatures, and allows you to Focus a specific creature. Focusing a creature increases the drop chance of its Essence.

sections.heading: Codex
sections.body: Unlocking Collections in the Codex gives small permanent boosts.
